# Art shows — sección archivada

Sección retirada del sitio. Insertar el HTML antes de la sección About y agregar el CSS al final de `dist/style.css`. Guardar el SVG como `dist/assets/art-shows-stan.svg`.

## HTML

```html
<section class="art-shows section" id="art-shows" aria-labelledby="art-shows-title"><div class="art-shows-visual"><span class="art-shows-note">A LITTLE ART, OUT IN THE WORLD</span><img src="assets/art-shows-stan.svg" alt="Playful hand-drawn Stella character" width="908" height="854" loading="lazy"></div><div class="art-shows-copy"><p class="eyebrow">COME SAY HELLO</p><h2 id="art-shows-title">Art shows</h2><p class="art-shows-intro">Good things happen when we gather.</p><p>Come meet the pieces in person, find your favourite, and share a little moment of art. From local markets to pop-up shows, this is where you’ll find the next place to say hello.</p><div class="art-show-announcement"><p class="eyebrow">UP NEXT</p><h3>Something lovely is taking shape.</h3><p>New show dates and locations will be shared here as soon as they’re confirmed. Until then, get in touch for the latest from the studio.</p><a class="art-show-link" href="#contact">Ask about the next show <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div></section>
```

## CSS

```css
.art-shows{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8%;align-items:center;background:#c2b1d2;color:#091814;padding-top:90px;padding-bottom:90px}
.art-shows-visual{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:28px}
.art-shows-note{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-align:center}
.art-shows-visual img{width:100%;max-width:460px;height:auto;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.art-shows-copy h2{font-size:clamp(64px,7vw,108px);line-height:1.05;margin:18px 0 24px}
.art-shows-copy>p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:20px;line-height:1.4;max-width:520px}
.art-shows-copy .art-shows-intro{font-family:Awesome,Georgia,serif;font-size:32px!important;line-height:1.15!important;margin-bottom:18px}
.art-show-announcement{border-top:1px solid #09181455;margin-top:32px;padding-top:26px}
.art-show-announcement h3{font-size:34px;line-height:1.15;margin:14px 0}
.art-show-announcement>p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:18px;line-height:1.4;max-width:500px}
.art-show-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;margin-top:24px;font-size:18px}
.art-show-link:hover{opacity:.7}
@media(max-width:700px){.art-shows{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;padding:55px 6% 60px}.art-shows-visual img{max-width:290px}.art-shows-note{font-size:11px}.art-shows-copy h2{font-size:68px}.art-shows-copy>p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:18px}.art-show-announcement h3{font-size:30px}}
```
